description: This file defines the Frame class in the Playwright automation library, handling browser frame operations including navigation, element interactions, and lifecycle events within a webpage.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a browser frame in Playwright, providing methods to interact with frame content, navigation, and event handling within the frame context.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates the frame to a specified URL and waits for load state.

methods.name: waitForNavigation
methods.description: Waits for the frame to navigate to a new URL, optionally matching a specific URL pattern.

methods.name: waitForLoadState
methods.description: Waits for the frame to reach a specific load state such as 'load', 'domcontentloaded', or 'networkidle'.

methods.name: waitForURL
methods.description: Waits until the frame's URL matches a given pattern.

methods.name: frameElement
methods.description: Returns a handle to the element in the parent document that hosts this frame.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Executes a script in the frame context and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Executes a script in the frame context and returns the result.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Returns the full HTML markup of the frame content.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the HTML content of the frame.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Clicks on an element identified by the selector.

methods.name: dblclick
methods.description: Double-clicks on an element identified by the selector.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills an input element with the specified value.

methods.name: hover
methods.description: Hovers the mouse over an element.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects options in a <select> element.

methods.name: setInputFiles
methods.description: Sets files for an input element.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Types text into an input element.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an attribute on an element.

methods.name: getByTestId
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with a specific test ID.

methods.name: getByAltText
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements matching alt text.

methods.name: getByLabel
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements matching label text.

methods.name: getByPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements matching placeholder text.

methods.name: getByText
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements containing specific text.

methods.name: getByTitle
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with specific title text.

methods.name: getByRole
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements matching a specific ARIA role.

methods.name: frameLocator
methods.description: Creates a frame locator scoped within this frame.
